data.current_description:
The Copy API, also known as Cloud Clone, lets you make a copy of an existing dataset.
It offers an alternative to exporting and importing a dataset.
This feature is also [available in the CLI](https://www.sanity.io/docs/content-lake/how-to-use-cloud-clone-for-datasets).
All requests to this endpoint must be [authenticated](https://www.sanity.io/docs/content-lake/http-auth).

### Check the status of the copy operation
You can check the status of the copy operation by making a request to the [Jobs API](https://www.sanity.io/docs/http-reference/jobs) with the returned `jobId`.

### Content releases in the copy
Unless you set `skipContentReleases`, content releases and their document versions are copied to the target dataset. Scheduled releases are unscheduled in the copy: they arrive with the `active` state and without a `publishAt` time.

### Paid feature
This feature is part of our Advanced Dataset Management offering on the enterprise plan. Contact us if you need this feature and want to discuss this plan.
data.summary_suggestion: Create a copy of an existing dataset
data.description_suggestion: Initiates an asynchronous copy operation to duplicate an existing dataset to a target dataset. Requires authentication with appropriate permissions. Returns a CopyJob object containing a jobId that can be used to track the operation status via the Jobs API. By default, content releases and their document versions are copied to the target dataset; scheduled releases are converted to active state without publishAt times. Use the skipContentReleases parameter to exclude releases from the copy. This is an enterprise feature requiring Advanced Dataset Management.
